## Triage Summary

This issue contains multiple independent concerns that are better tracked separately. I've created individual issues for each one — see the links below.

Splitting allows each concern to be triaged, prioritized, and implemented independently.

sub_issues.title: docs: add troubleshooting row for pagination cap
sub_issues.body:
